title: Manual source-body review — fourteen new Hebrew Sicha, Q&A and event-report texts
review_method: Manual public web/search/open inspection of fourteen accessible item-level Hebrew body pages at he.chabad.org. Search was used only for candidate discovery; all response propositions derive from opened body passages, not titles or search extracts. One existing identity (AID 2989588) was rechecked but not duplicated. A separate existing identity (AID 2989585) was enriched in-place in batch 100 during the same run.
